newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai March exports up 4.8 pct, 4.4 pct in Jan/Apr.
newsitem.headline: Thai March exports up 4.8 pct, 4.4 pct in Jan/Apr.

text.p: Bank of Thailand Governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Monday Thai exports rose 4.8 percent year on year in March and averaged 4.4 percent growth during the first four months of this year.
The governor told reporters his preliminary export figures were based on foreign exchange transactions that local exporters and importers conducted through the central bank.
"Our exports continued to show a sign of recovery," the governor said.
There was no separate figure for April immediately available from the preliminary figures.
Rerngchai said central bank plans to issue three to four new monetary measures this week, but declined to elaborate.
Thai exports contracted by 0.2 percent in 1996 after growing by more than 20 percent in the previous year.
The sluggish export performance growth last year contributed to the sagging economy which saw GDP growth of 6.7 percent, the slowest rate in decade, compared with 8.7 percent in 1995, analysts said.
